title: [review] project-LICHEN-iaui.3: Responder new() returns Ok but sig is Self (compile error)
description: Bug in rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:1042. EdhocResponder::new at line 1034 has return type "-> Self" (not Result). The Zeroizing edit at line 1035 wrapped the seed, then line 1042 returns Ok(Self { ... }) instead of Self { ... }. Type mismatch -> compile fail. Initiator line 687 is correct (Self { ... } without Ok). Fix: remove Ok() wrapper.
